column4: dialect-gated: guards on CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL being unset and skips ONCE, like TestEveryShippedTenantPolicyExistsInTheBuiltDatabase and unlike a registeredBackends test which costs two here. Measured by name rather than by delta, with no DSN at all: go test ./engine/ -run TestMSSQLCapabilityFollowsTheInstalledPredicate -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one. Guards cleat#1541: MSSQLStore.CheckCrossTenantCapability had NO test on this dialect -- every existing TestCheckCrossTenantCapability_* case builds a PostgresStore -- which is why it could answer from IS_ROLEMEMBER alone while a member under the plain predicate sees zero rows. A PostgreSQL-only run cannot vouch for it, so the arm has to exist even where it skips.
dialect-gated: same single gate as the cluster line above, same measurement. This job supplies no SQL Server either, so the test skips once and the PostgreSQL work in the package runs.
